precheck.description: ensure RLS policy "promo_sponsored_access_e06cf260" does not exist
precheck.sql: SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 AS "one" FROM "pg_policies" WHERE ("schemaname" = $1 AND "tablename" = $2 AND "policyname" = $3)) AS "result"

execute.sql: CREATE POLICY "promo_sponsored_access_e06cf260" ON "public"."promo_redemptions" AS PERMISSIVE FOR SELECT TO PUBLIC USING (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.pro_sponsorships s WHERE s.sponsor_id=promo_redemptions.user_id AND s.user_id=nullif(current_setting('vops.user_id',true),'')::integer AND s.organization_id=current_setting('vops.organization_id',true) AND s.active))

postcheck.sql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 AS "one" FROM "pg_policies" WHERE ("schemaname" = $1 AND "tablename" = $2 AND "policyname" = $3)) AS "result"
